eligibility: Offer for an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree at UWA for 2026.
Equivalent minimum ATAR 85.00 (undergraduate) or minimum WAM 65.00 (postgraduate).
Final academic transcripts submitted (conditional offers may not include scholarship).
existing.eligibility_summary: International student with an offer for an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree at UWA for 2026; minimum equivalent ATAR 85.00 (undergraduate) or minimum WAM 65.00 (postgraduate).
benefits: Undergraduate: up to AUD 48,000 over 4 years (ATAR 98+ = AUD 12,000/year; 90–97.95 = AUD 10,000/year; 85–89.95 = AUD 6,000/year).
Postgraduate: up to AUD 24,000 over 2 years (WAM 85+ = AUD 12,000/year; 75–84.99 = AUD 10,000/year; 65–74.99 = AUD 6,000/year).
Annual tuition fee discount applied per semester.
